verses.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
verses.pt: Todos os mandamentos que hoje eu vos ordeno cuidareis de observar, para que vivais, e vos multipliqueis, e entreis, e possuais a terra que o Senhor, com juramento, prometeu a vossos pais.
verses.en_web: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.
verses.en_bbe: Take care to keep all the orders which I give you today, so that you may have life and be increased and go in and take as a heritage the land which the Lord, by his oath to your fathers, undertook to give you.

verses.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
verses.pt: E te lembrarás de todo o caminho pelo qual o Senhor teu Deus tem te conduzido durante estes quarenta anos no deserto, a fim de te humilhar e te provar, para saber o que estava no teu coração, se guardarias ou não os seus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to prove you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or not.
verses.en_bbe: And keep in mind the way by which the Lord your God has taken you through the waste land these forty years, so that he might make low your pride and put you to the test, to see what was in your heart and if you would keep his orders or not.

verses.en: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
verses.pt: Sim, ele te humilhou, e te deixou ter fome, e te sustentou com o maná, que nem tu nem teus pais conhecíeis; para te dar a entender que o homem não vive só de pão, mas de tudo o que sai da boca do Senhor, disso vive o homem.
verses.en_web: He humbled you, and allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know; that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.
verses.en_bbe: And he made low your pride and let you be without food and gave you manna for your food, a thing new to you, which your fathers never saw; so that he might make it clear to you that bread is not man's only need, but his life is in every word which comes out of the mouth of the Lord.

verses.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verses.pt: Não se envelheceram as tuas vestes sobre ti, nem se inchou o teu pé, nestes quarenta anos.
verses.en_web: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
verses.en_bbe: Through all these forty years your clothing did not get old or your feet become tired.

verses.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.pt: Saberás, pois, no teu coração que, como um homem corrige a seu filho, assim te corrige o Senhor teu Deus.
verses.en_web: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind this thought, that as a son is trained by his father, so you have been trained by the Lord your God.

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.pt: E guardarás os mandamentos de Senhor teu Deus, para andares nos seus caminhos, e para o temeres.
verses.en_web: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.en_bbe: Then keep the orders of the Lord your God, fearing him and walking in his ways.

verses.en: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor teu Deus te está introduzindo numa boa terra, terra de ribeiros de águas, de fontes e de nascentes, que brotam nos vales e nos outeiros;
verses.en_web: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord your God is guiding you into a good land, a land of water-springs, of fountains, and deep streams flowing out from the valleys and the hills;

verses.en: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
verses.pt: terra de trigo e cevada; de vides, figueiras e romeiras; terra de oliveiras, de azeite e de mel;
verses.en_web: a land of wheat and barley, and vines and fig trees and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
verses.en_bbe: A land of grain and vines and fig-trees and fair fruits; a land of oil-giving olive-trees and honey;

verses.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verses.pt: terra em que comerás o pão sem escassez, e onde não te faltará coisa alguma; terra cujas pedras são ferro, e de cujos montes poderás cavar o cobre.
verses.en_web: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarceness, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
verses.en_bbe: Where there will be bread for you in full measure and you will be in need of nothing; a land where the very stones are iron and from whose hills you may get copper.

verses.en: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verses.pt: Comerás, pois, e te fartarás, e louvarás ao Senhor teu Deus pela boa terra que te deu.
verses.en_web: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.
verses.en_bbe: And you will have food enough and be full, praising the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.

verses.en: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
verses.pt: Guarda-te, que não te esqueças do Senhor teu Deus, deixando de observar os seus mandamentos, os seus preceitos e os seus estatutos, que eu hoje te ordeno;
verses.en_web: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, and his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
verses.en_bbe: Then take care that you are not turned away from the Lord your God and from keeping his orders and decisions and laws which I give you this day:

verses.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
verses.pt: para não suceder que, depois de teres comido e estares farto, depois de teres edificado boas casas e estares morando nelas,
verses.en_web: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses, and lived in them;
verses.en_bbe: And when you have taken food and are full, and have made fair houses for yourselves and are living in them;

verses.en: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.pt: depois de se multiplicarem as tuas manadas e es teus rebanhos, a tua prata e o teu ouro, sim, depois de se multiplicar tudo quanto tens,
verses.en_web: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
verses.en_bbe: And when your herds and your flocks are increased, and your stores of silver and gold, and you have wealth of every sort;

verses.en: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.pt: se exalte e teu coração e te esqueças do Senhor teu Deus, que te tirou da terra o Egito, da casa da servidão;
verses.en_web: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;
verses.en_bbe: Take care that your hearts are not lifted up in pride, giving no thought to the Lord your God who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house;

verses.en: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.pt: que te conduziu por aquele grande e terrível deserto de serpentes abrasadoras e de escorpiões, e de terra árida em que não havia água, e onde te fez sair água da rocha pederneira;
verses.en_web: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
verses.en_bbe: Who was your guide through that great and cruel waste, where there were poison-snakes and scorpions and a dry land without water; who made water come out of the hard rock for you;

verses.en: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
verses.pt: que no deserto te alimentou com o maná, que teus pais não conheciam; a fim de te humilhar e te provar, para nos teus últimos dias te fazer bem;
verses.en_web: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know; that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end:
verses.en_bbe: Who gave you manna for your food in the waste land, a food which your fathers had never seen; so that your pride might be broken and your hearts tested for your good in the end;

verses.en: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
verses.pt: e digas no teu coração: A minha força, e a fortaleza da minha mão me adquiriram estas riquezas.
verses.en_web: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”
verses.en_bbe: Say not then, in your hearts, My power and the strength of my hands have got me this wealth.

verses.en: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
verses.pt: Antes te lembrarás do Senhor teu Deus, porque ele é o que te dá força para adquirires riquezas; a fim de confirmar o seu pacto, que jurou a teus pais, como hoje se vê.
verses.en_web: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth; that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.
verses.en_bbe: But keep in mind the Lord your God: for it is he who gives you the power to get wealth, so that he may give effect to the agreement which he made by his oath with your fathers, as at this day.

verses.en: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.pt: Sucederá, porém, que, se de qualquer maneira te esqueceres de Senhor teu Deus, e se seguires após outros deuses, e os servires, e te encurvares perante eles, testifico hoje contra ti que certamente perecerás.
verses.en_web: It shall be, if you shall forget Yahweh your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.
verses.en_bbe: And it is certain that if at any time you are turned away from the Lord your God, and go after other gods, to be their servants and to give them worship, destruction will overtake you.

verses.en: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Como as nações que o Senhor vem destruindo diante de vós, assim vós perecereis, por não quererdes ouvir a voz do Senhor vosso Deus. rovas, de sinais, de maravilhas, de peleja,
verses.en_web: As the nations that Yahweh makes to perish before you, so you shall perish; because you wouldn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
verses.en_bbe: Like the nations which the Lord is cutting off before you, so you will be cut off; because you would not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God.
